cards.title: Apate Sends AI Agents Undercover to Catch Fraud
cards.body: Apate.ai takes an unconventional approach by deploying AI agents to deliberately get scammed and gather fraud intelligence. Unlike typical AI use cases focused on speed and efficiency, the startup uses this data to help companies understand and prevent fraud.

cards.title: Deezer Launches AI-Generated Music Filter Toggle
cards.body: Deezer announced a new feature allowing users to filter out AI-generated music from their listening experience. The toggle will roll out by the end of 2026.

cards.title: Zenzap Raises $44M for Workplace Chat Platform
cards.body: Zenzap secured $44M in funding for its AI chat app designed to replace WhatsApp in enterprise environments. The platform is already used by major organizations like Starbucks and Taco Bell.

cards.title: Floqer's AI Agents Automate Sales Research
cards.body: Floqer developed AI agents that research sales prospects, reducing manual work for revenue teams. The platform tackles a widespread pain point in sales and operations workflows.

cards.title: Scimplify Raises $25M for Critical Materials AI
cards.body: Scimplify secured $25M to challenge China's dominance in critical materials using AI technology. The company has tripled its annualized revenue run rate to $200M and is expanding into the U.S. market.

cards.title: Science Corporation Implants Vision-Restoring Chip
cards.body: Science Corporation, led by former Neuralink co-founder Max Hodak, successfully implanted its PRIMA vision-restoring chip in its first Stargardt disease patient. The milestone represents progress toward advancing brain-computer interface technology.

cards.title: Cerebras CEO Predicts Personal AI Assistants Everywhere
cards.body: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman envisions a future where personal AI assistants become household staples, running partly locally and partly in the cloud. He believes this shift will fundamentally change how people interact with technology.

cards.title: Industrial Next Enables Rapid Robot Task Switching
cards.body: Industrial Next helps manufacturers reprogram factory robots to switch tasks in minutes instead of weeks. The platform automates complex, delicate tasks traditionally requiring human labor.

cards.title: Cerebras CEO Critiques AI Doomsday Narratives
cards.body: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman argued at TechCrunch Disrupt that AI leaders spreading doomsday warnings are drowning out potential benefits. He called for the industry to balance risk discussions with opportunity conversations.

cards.title: Judge Orders OpenAI to Disclose Apple Records
cards.body: A federal judge ruled that Apple can access OpenAI's hiring records, private messages, and testimony from key figures in their trade secrets case. The ruling specifically covers interview materials involving former Apple employees.

cards.title: Flox Intelligence Deploys AI to Protect Wildlife
cards.body: Flox Intelligence developed AI systems that identify animals and use species-specific sounds to keep them away from trains, airports, and roads. The edge-based solution helps protect both wildlife and critical infrastructure.

cards.title: Meta Launches "Your Algorithm" Control Feature
cards.body: Meta announced an AI-powered feature called "Your Algorithm" that gives users greater control over their feed. The feature follows Meta's earlier Instagram rollout.

cards.title: Laplace Intelligence Red-Teams Robots and Vehicles
cards.body: Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and autonomous vehicles before real-world deployment. The University of Michigan spinout competed at TechCrunch Disrupt's Startup Battlefield.

cards.title: Pluto Security Raises $42M for Enterprise AI Safety
cards.body: Pluto Security raised $42M to address security vulnerabilities emerging from widespread AI tool adoption in enterprises. The platform helps companies manage unexpected and risky AI usage patterns across their organizations.

cards.title: Google Play Enables Private AI-Generated Android Apps
cards.body: Google Play now allows developers to build and use personal Android apps created with AI without publishing them publicly. The initiative lowers barriers for creating private, custom applications.

cards.title: Satlyt Positions Itself as Orbital Computing Android
cards.body: Satlyt offers open-source software for satellites, competing with SpaceX's closed, proprietary approach to space computing. The platform aims to enable flexible satellite applications across multiple companies' hardware.

cards.title: SpaceXSI Bundles X Premium, Grok, and Cursor
cards.body: The new X Subscription combines X's paid features with AI tools like Grok and Cursor into unified plans. Pricing ranges from $8 to $200 per month depending on tier.

cards.title: Open Models: Benefits vs. Security Risks
cards.body: Anthropic released a report arguing that powerful open AI models like GLM-5.3 pose major cyberattack risks. The debate centers on whether open model benefits outweigh their potential security vulnerabilities.

cards.title: AI Labs Buying Data from Failed Startups
cards.body: AI companies are acquiring datasets from defunct startups to train their models, creating a new market for digital archives. One entrepreneur netted $25,000 selling his startup's codebase to AI labs.

cards.title: AI Models' Refusal Problem Overstated
cards.body: Current AI models are trained to refuse harmful prompts, but researchers question whether this safety mechanism is as reliable as assumed. The reliance on AI's ability to say no may be misplaced.

cards.title: Anthropic Warns of IoT Self-Replication Risk
cards.body: Anthropic warns that small AI models could potentially self-replicate through IoT devices, posing emerging security concerns. The research highlights underappreciated risks in distributed AI deployment.

cards.title: OpenAI, Google Models Tricked Into Generating Nudes
cards.body: Researchers discovered that new AI models from OpenAI and Google can be easily manipulated into generating explicit images. The findings reveal critical safety gaps in current generation models.

cards.title: Disney Acquires Character.AI Chatbot Technology
cards.body: Disney is offering $20 million to acquire Character.AI's chatbot technology amid the platform's ongoing scandals. The acquisition reflects growing corporate interest in conversational AI despite reputational challenges.

cards.title: Epic Games Shifts to AI-First Development
cards.body: Epic Games is reportedly pivoting toward an "AI first" game development model to streamline production. The strategic shift signals growing integration of AI tools in the gaming industry.
